exposure: Bilateral uterine artery and vein ligation (LIG)
Time after surgery (4 h, 24 h, 72 h)
outcome: Gene expression of placental nutrient transporters (h-FABP, CD36, SNAT1, SNAT2, GLUT-1, Connexin 26)
Protein expression of placental nutrient transporters (h-FABP, CD36, SNAT1, SNAT2, GLUT-1, Connexin 26)
cohort: Pregnant rats on gestational day E19.
finding: Placental fatty acid transporter (h-FABP, CD36) protein expression was increased, while amino acid (SNAT1, SNAT2) and glucose (GLUT-1, Connexin 26) transporter expression was reduced, demonstrating differential effects of reduced blood flow and surgical stress on placental nutrient transport.
